privacy.title: Privacy Policy & GDPR
privacy.manageCookiesSub: Update or reset your tracking consent settings at any time.

overview.heading: Overview
overview.text: At Cavaleiros da Francesinha, we process your personal data securely and transparently in compliance with the European General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

dataCollection.heading: Information We Collect
dataCollection.accountText: Authentication credentials, submitted review text, ingredient scores, ratings, and uploaded dish photos.
dataCollection.analyticsText: Anonymous page views, device metrics, and interaction logs via Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager (GTM).

cookies.heading: Cookies & Google Consent Mode v2
cookies.intro: We implement Google Consent Mode v2 to ensure non-essential analytics scripts run only when explicitly authorized.
cookies.essentialDesc: Required for page navigation, session security, and recording your cookie choice.
cookies.analyticsDesc: Used to aggregate traffic statistics and improve application performance. Disabled by default.

infrastructure.heading: Infrastructure & Storage
infrastructure.intro: All data processing is hosted within secure European cloud infrastructure:
infrastructure.supabase: Supabase (EU): Relational database and image storage buckets.
infrastructure.vercel: Vercel: Serverless application hosting and CDN edge distribution.

rights.heading: Your Rights Under GDPR
rights.intro: You hold complete authority over your personal information:
rights.accessDesc: Request a complete copy of stored account data.
rights.rectificationDesc: Update or correct inaccurate profile details.
rights.erasureDesc: Request permanent deletion of your account and reviews.
rights.contact: To exercise your rights, email us at:
